objects.name: idx_artifact_versions_created_at
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_versions_created_at
                    ON artifact_versions(created_at DESC)

objects.name: idx_artifact_versions_run_id
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_versions_run_id
                    ON artifact_versions(run_id, created_at DESC)

objects.name: idx_audit_ts
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_ts ON audit_events(ts, event_type)

objects.name: idx_messages_thread
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_thread ON chat_messages(thread_id, timestamp)

objects.name: idx_steps_task
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_steps_task ON task_steps(task_id, idx)

objects.name: allowed_folders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE allowed_folders (
                    path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
                )

objects.name: artifact_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifact_versions (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    run_id TEXT,
                    label TEXT,
                    source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
                    format TEXT NOT NULL,
                    size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
                    preview TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )

objects.name: audit_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    ts TEXT NOT NULL,
                    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                    resource_type TEXT,
                    resource_id TEXT,
                    details_json TEXT
                )

objects.name: chat_messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    role TEXT NOT NULL,
                    content TEXT NOT NULL,
                    timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES chat_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )

objects.name: chat_threads
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_threads (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )

objects.name: schema_version
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_version(version INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: task_steps
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_steps (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    idx INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                    requires_approval INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'low',
                    output TEXT,
                    FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
                )

objects.name: tasks
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE tasks (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL,
                    prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
                    thread_id TEXT,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    error TEXT,
                    FOREIGN KEY(thread_id) REFERENCES chat_threads(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
                )
